summary: User can log in with email and password
description: As a registered user I want to sign in so I can access my dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the login page
When I enter a valid email and password and submit
Then I am redirected to the dashboard
And I see a welcome message with my name
Given I am on the login page
When I enter an invalid password and submit
Then I remain on the login page
And I see an error message "Invalid credentials"

summary: Shopper can add a product to the cart
description: As a shopper I want to add items to my cart so I can check out later.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product "Wireless Mouse" is available for $29.99
And my cart is empty
When I add "Wireless Mouse" to the cart
Then the cart contains 1 item
And the cart total is $29.99
When I add "Wireless Mouse" to the cart again
Then the cart contains 2 items
And the cart total is $59.98

description: As a user who forgot my password I want a reset code emailed so I can regain access.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user exists with email "reset.me@example.com"
When I request a password reset for "reset.me@example.com"
Then a 6-digit reset code is generated
And an email is queued to "reset.me@example.com"
When I submit an incorrect reset code
Then the reset is rejected
When I submit the correct reset code and a new password
Then I can log in with the new password
